text:
11ax 3000Mbps Ceiling Wireless AP
This is a high-performance, high-speed 11ax indoor dual-band ceiling AP that can provide 2.4G and 5.8GHz dual-band wireless services. 2.4G provides up to 574Mbps access rate, and 5G provides up to 2402Mbps access rate.
Key Features
• With better transmission quality and higher transmission rate, the overall concurrent rate can reach up to 3000Mbps.
• Support hardware watchdog function, automatic recovery of abnormal equipment, and maintenance free.
• Elegant appearance design, port concealed housing, and beautiful wiring.
• Supports two power supply modes: 48V PoE and DC 12V.
